name: Innova Captab Ltd
title: Innova Captab Ltd - 544067 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Revenue up 31% to INR1,630 cr and Q4 up 42%, but PAT up only 10% to INR140.9 cr; Jammu ~INR300 cr FY26 near EBITDA breakeven, with management guiding 20%+ volume growth for FY27 and a new Baddi block of INR150-170 cr capex.

utilisation.quote: that is on the higher utilization side

capex.quote: the overall capital outlay should be in the range of INR150 crores, INR170 crores

triggers.label: New Baddi block capex INR150-170 cr
triggers.quote: the overall capital outlay should be in the range of INR150 crores, INR170 crores

triggers.label: Cephalosporin prices fell in Q2-Q3, stabilised Q4
triggers.quote: our cephalosporin prices have reduced during the quarter 2 and quarter 3 of this financial year and started stabilizing

triggers.label: FY27 20%+ volume growth reiterated
triggers.quote: we would like to maintain that we are very much confident of maintaining that 20% plus volume growth

triggers.label: Q4 revenue up 42% YoY
triggers.quote: Q4 revenue come at INR448 crores, delivering a strong growth of 42%

guidance.quote: we are confident in our ability to deliver 20% plus revenue growth
we will maintain that overall at a group level, we will maintain that 20% plus volume growth
we should be able to achieve EBITDA positive as well as start covering the fixed cost on Jammu part
we expect that there should be a few percent point improvement in the EBITDA
the overall capital outlay should be in the range of INR150 crores, INR170 crores

red_flags.label: PAT growth 10% vs revenue 31%
red_flags.quote: Profit after tax stood at INR140.9 crores with a growth of 10% on a year -on-year basis

red_flags.label: Gross margin down despite branded mix shift
red_flags.quote: the change in gross margin profile is mainly due to the change in product mix

red_flags.label: Customer and segment breakups withheld
red_flags.quote: That quantitative breakup may not be available as of now.

evasions.quote: we normally do not track our business area revenue at a capability level
That quantitative breakup may not be available as of now.
this is, again, a complex area to comment on the margin expansion
